title: Automated Exploit and Security Test Generation: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2502.04953v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Static analysis techniques are often insufficient to determine whether a reported security vulnerability is exploitable and actually poses a real security risk to a software application. Dynamic analysis addresses this limitation by executing the target application with carefully crafted inputs that trigger or reproduce a given vulnerability. Over the past two decades, automatic exploit generation (AEG) and automatic security test generation (ASTG) have emerged as active research areas in cybersecurity and software engineering.   This paper demystifies the field by establishing consistent terminology and presenting a systematic literature review (SLR) of research published in the last two decades. Starting from an initial set of 3,309 publications obtained from academic literature search engines, we selected and analyzed 71 papers comprising 67 distinct studies. translated_title: 自动化漏洞利用与安全测试生成：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 静态分析技术往往不足以判断一个被报告的安全漏洞是否可被利用、是否真的会对软件应用构成实际安全风险。动态分析通过使用精心构造的输入执行目标应用程序，以触发或重现给定漏洞，从而弥补了这一局限。在过去二十年中，自动漏洞利用生成（AEG）和自动安全测试生成（ASTG）已成为网络安全与软件工程领域的活跃研究方向。本文通过建立统一的术语体系，并对过去二十年发表的研究进行系统性文献综述（SLR），厘清了该领域的全貌。从学术文献搜索引擎获取的3,309篇初始文献出发，我们筛选并分析了71篇论文，涵盖67项独立研究。我们系统地比较了现有的AEG与ASTG方法……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 本文对过去二十年的71篇论文（67项独立研究）进行了系统性文献综述，建立了自动漏洞利用生成（AEG）与自动安全测试生成（ASTG）领域的统一术语体系，并系统比较了现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic literature review of 71 papers (67 distinct studies) from the past two decades, establishing consistent terminology and systematically comparing existing approaches in automatic exploit generation (AEG) and automatic security test generation (ASTG).
